lemma lemma2 {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) :
  Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} ≤ Subgroup.closure ({a, b} : Set G) := by

  have hb : b ∈ Subgroup.closure ({a, b} : Set G) := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)

  · aesop
  · aesop
lemma b_eq_inv_mul {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : b = (b * a * b^2)⁻¹ * (b * a * b^3) := by group

lemma b_mem {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : b ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := by
  have hx : b*a*b^2 ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hy : b*a*b^3 ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have h : (b*a*b^2)⁻¹ * (b*a*b^3) ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx) hy
  rw [← b_eq_inv_mul a b] at h
  exact h

lemma a_mem {G : Type*} [Group G] (a b : G) : a ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := by
  have hx : b*a*b^2 ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hb : b ∈ Subgroup.closure {b*a*b^2, b*a*b^3} := b_mem a b

A `Group` is a `Monoid` with an operation `⁻¹` satisfying `a⁻¹ * a = 1`.

There is also a division operation `/` such that `a / b = a * b⁻¹`,
with a default so that `a / b = a * b⁻¹` holds by definition.

Use `Group.ofLeftAxioms` or `Group.ofRightAxioms` to define a group structure
on a type with the minimum proof obligations.
